meta.pipeline_under_test: decision-engine (Stage 0 reframe -> decompose -> verify -> advise) and, by extension, the shared brain personalization
meta.built_from: canonical.md ICP (time-poor CEO/COO/founder making the AI-native version of their business) + docs/CTRL-SYSTEM-SPEC.md session-journey (cold/warm/rich)
scoring_axes: personalization_specificity (swap-test: would a different profile change this materially? if not, score 1)
meta.recommendation: commit this file to the repo and run the reframe+advise pipeline against it pre-release; assert each output scores >=3 on all four axes and that personalization_specificity swap-test passes.

profiles.persona: CFO of a 200-person B2B fintech, rich brain (industry=fintech, role=CFO, goals=cut cost-to-serve, prior decisions logged)
profiles.input_decision: Should we hire two more support agents to handle ticket volume?
profiles.expected_output_characteristics: Reframe to AI-native (agent owns tier-1 support before headcount); answer references cost-to-serve / unit economics (CFO lens); names a concrete pilot + a human checkpoint; not generic

profiles.persona: COO of a healthcare services company, rich brain (industry=healthcare, role=COO, compliance-sensitive)
profiles.input_decision: Should we hire two more support agents to handle ticket volume?
profiles.expected_output_characteristics: SAME input as gp01 but output must differ materially: healthcare/compliance framing (PHI, human sign-off, regulatory exposure) vs gp01's unit-economics framing. This pair is the personalization swap-test.
